name: Band Seated Hip Internal Rotation
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your knees bent at 90 degrees and a loop resistance band wrapped around both ankles.
Plant one foot firmly on the floor and keep both thighs parallel and stationary.
Swing your working foot smoothly outward against the band while keeping that knee still to internally rotate the hip.
Guide your foot slowly back to neutral under control, then switch sides after finishing one leg.
tips: Keep your thighs parallel without letting your working knee shift inward or lift off the chair.
Move through a comfortable hip range without twisting your pelvis on the seat.
